intro: 这一章把 KCL、KVL 和元件 VCR 变成**有固定套路的方程组**：支路电流法、网孔/回路电流法、结点电压法。选好未知量，按规则写出方程，就不用再靠“看出来”化简。要分清每种方法的未知量是谁，以及遇到电流源、电压源、受控源时怎样补方程。

en.intro: This chapter turns KCL, KVL and the element VCRs into **systematic sets of equations**: the branch-current method, mesh/loop analysis and nodal analysis. Choose the unknowns, write the equations by rule, and no clever simplification is needed. Know what the unknowns of each method are, and what extra equation a current source, voltage source or dependent source requires.

ideas.title: 独立方程的数目
text: 电路有 n 个结点、b 条支路时：独立的 KCL 方程有 **n − 1** 个（任选一个结点不列），独立的 KVL 方程有 **b − n + 1** 个（平面电路就是网孔数）。
各种方法的方程数：支路电流法 b 个；网孔/回路电流法 b − n + 1 个；结点电压法 n − 1 个。已知的支路电流（电流源）或已知的结点电压（接地电压源）会让方程再少一个。

en.title: How many independent equations
text: With n nodes and b branches there are **n − 1** independent KCL equations (leave out any one node) and **b − n + 1** independent KVL equations (the number of meshes of a planar circuit).

Equations per method: branch-current method b; mesh/loop analysis b − n + 1; nodal analysis n − 1. A known branch current (current source) or a known node voltage (grounded voltage source) removes one more.

ideas.title: 支路电流法
text: 以 b 个支路电流为未知数：先在图上标出每条支路电流的参考方向，列 n − 1 个结点的 KCL，再选 b − n + 1 个独立回路列 KVL（电阻电压用欧姆定律写成 R·i）。
含电流源的支路电流已知，列 KVL 时**避开**含电流源的回路（否则要多设一个电流源电压作未知数）。方程最多，但最直接，适合支路少的电路。

en.title: The branch-current method
text: Take the b branch currents as unknowns: mark the reference direction of every branch current, write KCL at n − 1 nodes, then KVL around b − n + 1 independent loops (resistor voltages written as R·i by Ohm's law).

A branch containing a current source has a known current; choose KVL loops that **avoid** the current source (otherwise its voltage becomes an extra unknown). It has the most equations but is the most direct; fine for circuits with few branches.

ideas.title: 网孔电流法：自电阻、互电阻
text: 设想每个网孔里有一个环流（网孔电流），各支路电流是流过它的网孔电流的代数和。网孔电流自动满足 KCL，只需对每个网孔列 KVL。
标准形式：自电阻 × 本网孔电流 + Σ 互电阻 × 相邻网孔电流 = 本网孔中电压源电压升的代数和。**自电阻**是网孔内所有电阻之和，总为正；**互电阻**是两个网孔公共支路的电阻，两网孔电流在公共支路上方向相反时取负（都取顺时针时总是负）。
电压源：沿网孔电流方向从“−”到“+”（电压升高）的取正。最后由网孔电流求支路电流（例如公共支路电流 = 两网孔电流之差）。

en.title: Mesh analysis: self- and mutual resistance
text: Imagine a circulating current in each mesh (the mesh current); every branch current is the algebraic sum of the mesh currents through it. Mesh currents satisfy KCL automatically, so only KVL is written, one equation per mesh.

Standard form: self-resistance × own mesh current + Σ mutual resistance × neighbouring mesh current = algebraic sum of the voltage-source rises in the mesh. The **self-resistance** is the sum of all resistances in the mesh (always positive); the **mutual resistance** is the resistance of the branch shared by two meshes, negative when the two mesh currents run through it in opposite directions (always so when both are clockwise).

Voltage sources: count positive when the mesh current goes through from “−” to “+” (a rise). Finally get the branch currents from the mesh currents (e.g. a shared branch carries the difference of two mesh currents).

ideas.title: 网孔/回路法遇到电流源：已知网孔电流、超网孔
text: 电流源只属于**一个**网孔（在电路外边界上）：这个网孔电流就等于 ±I_s，不用列它的 KVL。
电流源在两个网孔的**公共支路**上：两种做法——① 设电流源两端电压 v 为未知数，照常列两个网孔的 KVL，再补“两网孔电流之差 = I_s”；② 把两个网孔合成**超网孔**，沿外围（绕开电流源）列一个 KVL，再加同一个约束方程。
受控电流源同样处理，约束方程的右边是控制量的表达式。

en.title: Current sources in mesh analysis: known mesh currents and supermeshes
text: A current source in only **one** mesh (on the outer boundary): that mesh current equals ±I_s; no KVL is needed for it.

A current source in the branch **shared** by two meshes: either ① take its voltage v as an extra unknown, write both mesh KVLs as usual and add “difference of the two mesh currents = I_s”; or ② merge the two meshes into a **supermesh**, write one KVL around its outside (avoiding the current source) and add the same constraint.
A dependent current source is handled the same way; the constraint's right-hand side is then the expression of the controlling quantity.

ideas.title: 回路电流法：选独立回路
text: 回路电流法是网孔法的推广：任选 b − n + 1 个独立回路（每个新回路至少包含一条前面回路没用过的支路），回路不必是网孔，非平面电路也适用。
技巧：让每个电流源**只属于一个回路**，这个回路电流就已知，方程数减少。自电阻、互电阻的规则与网孔法相同，但互电阻要按两回路电流在公共支路上的方向是否相同来定正负。

en.title: Loop analysis: choosing independent loops
text: Loop analysis generalises mesh analysis: choose any b − n + 1 independent loops (each new loop contains at least one branch not used before); the loops need not be meshes, and non-planar circuits work too.

Trick: let each current source lie in **only one loop** — that loop current is then known and the system shrinks. Self- and mutual resistances follow the mesh rules, but the sign of a mutual resistance depends on whether the two loop currents run through the shared branch in the same direction.

ideas.title: 结点电压法：自电导、互电导
text: 选一个**参考结点**（电位为零），其余 n − 1 个结点对它的电压为未知数。结点电压自动满足 KVL，只需对每个独立结点列 KCL。
标准形式：自电导 × 本结点电压 + Σ 互电导 × 相邻结点电压 = 流入本结点的电源电流之和。**自电导**是接在该结点上所有支路电导之和，总为正；**互电导**是两结点之间支路电导之和的**负值**。
右边：电流源流入为正、流出为负；“电压源 V_s 串联电阻 R”的支路贡献 V_s/R（“+”端朝向本结点时为正）。与电流源串联的电阻不计入电导。求出结点电压后，支路电流 = 两端结点电压之差 / R。

en.title: Nodal analysis: self- and mutual conductance
text: Choose a **reference node** (potential zero); the voltages of the other n − 1 nodes to it are the unknowns. Node voltages satisfy KVL automatically, so only KCL is written at each independent node.

Standard form: self-conductance × own node voltage + Σ mutual conductance × neighbouring node voltage = sum of the source currents into the node. The **self-conductance** is the sum of the conductances of all branches at the node (always positive); the **mutual conductance** is **minus** the sum of the conductances between the two nodes.

Right-hand side: current sources entering count positive, leaving negative; a branch “voltage source V_s in series with R” contributes V_s/R (positive when its “+” faces the node). A resistor in series with a current source contributes no conductance. With the node voltages known, a branch current = difference of its end voltages / R.

ideas.title: 结点法遇到电压源：接参考结点、超结点
text: **无伴电压源**（没有串联电阻）的电流无法用结点电压表示，不能直接写进“自电导”形式。
电压源一端接参考结点：选好参考结点，另一端的结点电压**直接已知**（= ±V_s），不用列它的方程。
电压源接在两个非参考结点之间：① 设电压源电流为未知数，照常列两个结点的 KCL，再补约束 v_a − v_b = V_s；② 把两个结点合成**超结点**，对包围它们的闭合面列一个 KCL，再加同一个约束。受控电压源同样处理。

en.title: Voltage sources in nodal analysis: grounded sources and supernodes
text: The current of an **ideal voltage source** (no series resistor) cannot be written in terms of node voltages, so it does not fit the self-conductance form.
One end on the reference node: that makes the other node voltage **known** (= ±V_s); no equation is needed there.

Between two non-reference nodes: either ① take the source current as an extra unknown, write KCL at both nodes and add the constraint v_a − v_b = V_s; or ② merge the two nodes into a **supernode**, write one KCL for a closed surface around them, and add the same constraint. Dependent voltage sources are handled the same way.

ideas.title: 弥尔曼定理（两结点电路）
text: 只有两个结点（一个独立结点）的电路，结点电压法只有一个方程，直接写出来就是弥尔曼定理：结点电压 = 各支路“短路电流”之和 / 各支路电导之和。
注意每条电压源支路的正负：电压源“+”端朝向独立结点时 V_s/R 取正，反之取负；电流源流入取正。

en.title: Millman's theorem (two-node circuits)
text: With only two nodes (one independent node) nodal analysis has a single equation; written out it is Millman's theorem: node voltage = sum of the branches' short-circuit currents / sum of the branch conductances.
Mind the sign of each voltage-source branch: V_s/R is positive when the “+” faces the independent node, negative otherwise; current sources entering count positive.

ideas.title: 含受控源：先当独立源，再补控制量方程
text: 列网孔方程或结点方程时，先把受控源**当作独立源**写进方程（受控电压源放在 KVL 的电压源一侧，受控电流源放在 KCL 的注入电流一侧）。
再补一个**控制量方程**：把控制量用未知的网孔电流或结点电压表示（例如 i_x = i_m1 − i_m2，或 i_2 = v_a/R_2），代入后整理求解。
含受控源时，系数矩阵一般**不再对称**；只有受控源本身的 VCR 不同，其余规则完全一样。最后可以用功率平衡验算。

en.title: Dependent sources: treat as independent, then add the controlling equation
text: When writing mesh or nodal equations, first put each dependent source in **as if it were independent** (a controlled voltage source on the source side of the KVL, a controlled current source among the injected currents of the KCL).
Then add a **controlling-quantity equation**: express the controlling quantity in terms of the unknown mesh currents or node voltages (e.g. i_x = i_m1 − i_m2, or i_2 = v_a/R_2), substitute and solve.
With dependent sources the coefficient matrix is generally **no longer symmetric**; everything else follows the same rules. Check with the power balance at the end.

ideas.title: 方法的选择
text: 数一数：结点法 n − 1 个方程，网孔法 b − n + 1 个，选少的那种。结点多、网孔少（例如串联回路多）用网孔法；结点少、并联支路多用结点法。
电流源多时结点法方便（直接写在右边），电压源多时网孔法方便；接地的电压源对结点法是“白送”一个已知量。两种方法结果必然一致，可以互相验算。

en.title: Choosing a method
text: Count: nodal analysis needs n − 1 equations, mesh analysis b − n + 1; take the smaller. Many nodes but few meshes → mesh analysis; few nodes and many parallel branches → nodal analysis.

Current sources fit nodal analysis (they go straight to the right-hand side), voltage sources fit mesh analysis; a grounded voltage source hands nodal analysis a known node voltage. Both methods must give the same result, so one can check the other.

formulas.name: 独立方程数
formulas.when: n 为结点数、b 为支路数的连通电路；平面电路的 b − n + 1 等于网孔数。

en.name: Number of independent equations
en.when: Connected circuit with n nodes and b branches; for a planar circuit b − n + 1 is the number of meshes.

formulas.name: 网孔方程（第 k 个网孔）
formulas.when: R_{kk} = 网孔 k 中电阻之和（> 0）；R_{kj} = ± 公共支路电阻，两网孔电流在公共支路上同向取 +、反向取 −（全取顺时针时为 −）；v_{skk} = 沿 i_{mk} 方向电压源电压升之和。

en.name: Mesh equation (mesh k)
en.when: R_{kk} = sum of resistances in mesh k (> 0); R_{kj} = ± shared resistance, + if the two mesh currents run through it in the same direction, − if opposite (− when all are clockwise); v_{skk} = sum of source-voltage rises along i_{mk}.

formulas.name: 结点方程（第 k 个结点）
formulas.when: v_{nk} 为结点 k 对参考结点的电压；G_{kk} = 接在结点 k 上的电导之和（> 0），G_{kj} = −（结点 k、j 间电导之和）；i_{skk} = 流入结点 k 的电流源电流 + Σ V_s/R（“+”朝向结点 k 为正）。与电流源串联的电阻不计入。

en.name: Nodal equation (node k)
en.when: v_{nk} = voltage of node k to the reference; G_{kk} = sum of conductances at node k (> 0), G_{kj} = −(sum of conductances between k and j); i_{skk} = current-source currents into node k + Σ V_s/R (positive when “+” faces node k). Resistors in series with current sources are left out.

formulas.name: 弥尔曼定理
formulas.when: 只有两个结点的电路，v 为独立结点对参考结点的电压；V_{sk} 的“+”朝向独立结点取正，I_{sk} 流入独立结点取正；分母不含与电流源串联的电阻。

en.name: Millman's theorem
en.when: Two-node circuit, v = voltage of the independent node to the reference; V_{sk} positive when its “+” faces the independent node, I_{sk} positive when entering it; no resistor in series with a current source in the denominator.

formulas.name: 电流源约束（超网孔）
formulas.when: I_s 在网孔 1、2 的公共支路上，方向与 i_{m2} 相同、与 i_{m1} 相反；超网孔的 KVL 沿外围绕开电流源。

en.name: Current-source constraint (supermesh)
en.when: I_s in the branch shared by meshes 1 and 2, pointing along i_{m2} and against i_{m1}; the supermesh KVL goes around the outside, avoiding the source.

formulas.name: 电压源约束（超结点）
formulas.when: V_s 的“+”接结点 a、“−”接结点 b；超结点的 KCL 对包围 a、b 的闭合面列。一端接参考结点时直接 v_a = V_s。

en.name: Voltage-source constraint (supernode)
en.when: V_s with “+” at node a and “−” at node b; the supernode KCL is written for a closed surface around a and b. With b the reference, simply v_a = V_s.

formulas.name: 支路电流法
formulas.expr: (n − 1) 个 KCL + (b − n + 1) 个 KVL = b 个方程
formulas.when: 未知数为 b 个支路电流（按图中参考方向）；电流源支路电流已知时，KVL 回路避开电流源。

en.name: Branch-current method
en.when: Unknowns: the b branch currents (with the reference directions drawn); with a current-source branch known, choose KVL loops avoiding it.

formulas.name: 控制量方程
formulas.expr: 控制量 = f（网孔电流 / 结点电压）
formulas.when: 每个受控源一个；例如 i_x = i_{m1} − i_{m2}（i_x 在公共支路上与 i_{m1} 同向），i_2 = v_a/R_2。

en.name: Controlling-quantity equation
en.expr: controlling quantity = f(mesh currents / node voltages)
en.when: One per dependent source; e.g. i_x = i_{m1} − i_{m2} (i_x along i_{m1} in the shared branch), i_2 = v_a/R_2.

examples.title: 结点电压法：一个接地电压源、一个电流源
examples.statement: 图示电路中 V_s = 12 V，I_s = 1 A（向上注入结点 c），R_1 = 2 Ω，R_2 = 8 Ω，R_3 = 2 Ω，R_4 = 3 Ω。以底部为参考结点，用结点电压法求 v_b、v_c，以及两个电源吸收的功率。
steps: 1. **已知结点。** V_s 接在 a 与参考结点之间：v_a = 12 V，只剩 b、c 两个未知结点电压。

en.title: Nodal analysis with a grounded voltage source and a current source
en.statement: In the circuit V_s = 12 V, I_s = 1 A (upwards, into node c), R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = 8 Ω, R_3 = 2 Ω, R_4 = 3 Ω. With the bottom node as reference, use nodal analysis to find v_b, v_c and the power absorbed by both sources.
steps: 1. **Known node.** V_s is between a and the reference: v_a = 12 V, leaving only v_b and v_c unknown.

5. **Branch currents and powers.** R_1 carries (12 − 8)/2 = **2 A**, leaving the “+” of V_s: P_Us = −12 × 2 = **−24 W**; R_3 carries (8 − 6)/2 = **1 A**. I_s pushes 1 A into node c at 6 V (leaving at its “+”): P_Is = −6 × 1 = **−6 W**.
6. **Check:** the resistors absorb 2×2² + 8²/8 + 2×1² + 6²/3 = 8 + 8 + 2 + 12 = 30, the sources deliver 24 + 6 = 30 ✓.

examples.title: 网孔电流法：含电流控制电压源
examples.statement: 图示电路中 V_s = 12 V，R_1 = 2 Ω，R_2 = 2 Ω，R_3 = 1 Ω。电流控制电压源 H 的电压为 2i_x（“+”在下方），i_x 为 R_2 中向下的电流。网孔电流 i_m1、i_m2 均取顺时针方向。求 i_m1、i_m2、i_x 和 H 吸收的功率。
steps: 2. **网孔 2（顺时针），H 先当独立源：** 顺时针向下经过 H，是从“−”到“+”，电压升高 2i_x，放在右边：−R_2·i_m1 + (R_2 + R_3)i_m2 = 2i_x → −2i_m1 + 3i_m2 = 2i_x。
3. **控制量方程：** i_x 是公共支路中向下的电流，i_x = i_m1 − i_m2。代入：−2i_m1 + 3i_m2 = 2i_m1 − 2i_m2 → 4i_m1 = 5i_m2。（系数矩阵不再对称。）

en.title: Mesh analysis with a current-controlled voltage source
en.statement: In the circuit V_s = 12 V, R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = 2 Ω, R_3 = 1 Ω. The current-controlled voltage source H has voltage 2i_x (“+” at the bottom), where i_x is the downward current in R_2. Both mesh currents i_m1, i_m2 are clockwise. Find i_m1, i_m2, i_x and the power absorbed by H.

results.ask: voltage of H (“+” at the bottom)

steps: 2. **Mesh 2 (clockwise), H treated as independent first:** going clockwise, i.e. downwards through H, runs from “−” to “+”, a rise of 2i_x on the right-hand side: −R_2·i_m1 + (R_2 + R_3)i_m2 = 2i_x → −2i_m1 + 3i_m2 = 2i_x.

3. **Controlling equation:** i_x is the downward current in the shared branch, i_x = i_m1 − i_m2. Substituting: −2i_m1 + 3i_m2 = 2i_m1 − 2i_m2 → 4i_m1 = 5i_m2. (The coefficient matrix is no longer symmetric.)
5. **Powers.** H has 2i_x = **2 V** (“+” at the bottom); the 4 A mesh current runs down through H and leaves at “+”: P_H = −2 × 4 = **−8 W** (delivers); P_Us = −12 × 5 = **−60 W**.
6. **Check:** the resistors absorb 2×5² + 2×1² + 1×4² = 50 + 2 + 16 = 68, the sources deliver 60 + 8 = 68 ✓.

mistakes.text: 互电阻、互电导的符号写错。网孔电流都取顺时针时互电阻一律为负；结点法的互电导一律为负——自电阻、自电导才是正的。

en.text: Wrong signs on mutual terms. With all mesh currents clockwise every mutual resistance is negative; in nodal analysis every mutual conductance is negative — only self-terms are positive.

mistakes.text: 把与电流源串联的电阻也算进结点的自电导。这条支路的电流就是 I_s，与那个电阻无关，它不出现在结点方程里。

en.text: Including a resistor in series with a current source in the self-conductance. That branch carries I_s whatever the resistor is; it does not appear in the nodal equations.

mistakes.text: 无伴电压源接在两个非参考结点之间时，照常对每个结点写“自电导”形式的方程，漏掉了电压源的电流。要么设它的电流为未知数，要么用超结点并补约束 v_a − v_b = V_s。（网孔法中两网孔共用的电流源同理。）

en.text: Writing the usual self-conductance equations at both ends of an ideal voltage source between two non-reference nodes, forgetting its current. Either make that current an unknown or use a supernode plus v_a − v_b = V_s. (Likewise for a current source shared by two meshes.)

mistakes.text: 含受控源时漏写控制量方程，或者控制量的方向与图中参考方向不一致（例如把 i_x = i_m1 − i_m2 写反）。

en.text: Forgetting the controlling-quantity equation, or expressing the controlling quantity against its drawn reference direction (e.g. writing i_x = i_m1 − i_m2 the wrong way round).

mistakes.text: 网孔方程右边电压源的正负弄反：右边写的是沿网孔电流方向的电压**升**（从“−”到“+”为正），不是电压降。

en.text: Wrong sign of a source on the right of a mesh equation: the right-hand side holds voltage **rises** along the mesh current (“−” to “+” positive), not drops.

mistakes.text: 把网孔电流当成公共支路的电流。公共支路的电流是两个网孔电流的代数和（顺时针时为差），要换算后再求电压、功率。

en.text: Taking a mesh current as the current of a shared branch. A shared branch carries the algebraic sum of the two mesh currents (their difference when both are clockwise); convert before computing voltages or powers.
